items.title: CloudOrbit launches Friday June 12, 2026
items.body:
The first stable build of CloudOrbit drops on **Friday June 12** — we slipped one more week so the SSO + kubeconfig path could get one more pass with real corporate proxies. Same launch window as WattsOrbit.

- AWS SSO session manager, no terminal needed
- Auto-updates kubeconfig as you switch profiles
- Detects EKS clusters from your active session
- Works behind Cloudflare and corporate proxies

Free, native Rust binary. Sign up to get notified the moment it ships.
